register.description: Conflicting leaderboard high values in circulation
register.details: The prompt cites 0.4413 (first mention) and 0.3195 (later mention) as the current GEMSDOE leaderboard high. The sister GEMSDOE32 registry snapshot (fetched 2026-10-04 from its docs page) reads #1 nchuzhoy 0.3262, #2 DARD 0.3195, #3 alexoktaba 0.3042. The DrivenData public leaderboard (https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/leaderboard/) is login-walled from this sandbox and could not be re-fetched to arbitrate.
register.action: No organizer-confirmed score is used anywhere in this repo. All numbers produced here are labelled HOLDOUT-DTI; nothing is written as a projection of an organizer score.

register.description: Sister-site leaderboard listings may not correspond to organizer scores
register.details: GEMSDOE32's own site states 'NO ORGANISER SCORE EXISTS for this or any artifact in this repository' for its h33-h33-2-b2 artifact, while the GEMSDOE32 leaderboard listing cites h33-h33-2-b2-zeros: 0.2778 and its own snapshot cites 0.2708 as a base. The relationship between sister-site listings and organizer scores is unverified.
register.action: Treat every sister-site score as cited-only; verify against a submission-page receipt before using any of it as ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.

register.description: Competition training data is login-walled; not organizer-authenticated here
register.details: training_features.tif, labels.tif and sample_submission.tif require DrivenData login (https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/data/). This repo restores integrity-pinned owner mirrors (buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE and GEMSDOE24 at pinned git refs, sha256-verified) solely to run the holdout; the bytes are NOT organizer-authenticated.
register.action: Anyone reproducing results must re-download from the official data page with their own credentials and re-verify sha256.
